about: Mercier is a city in Montérégie, Quebec, southwest of Montréal on the Châteauguay River corridor toward Sainte-Martine. Suburban growth, local commerce, and quick Highway 30 / 138 access to the South Shore job market define a residential off-island community. About 14,000 people live in Mercier.
